verdicts.reason: Quotes verify verbatim (07.06.02:217 D-06, :220 D-09, :84, :118, :161), but the file explicitly reconciles them. Both decisions derive from the SAME deep-think row, and that row settles authority: 07.06.02:182 — 'D-09 sets the budget and D-10 the arbitration.' D-06's own cited function is field-exclusion, not a numeric budget ('every added field cuts completion. Cited by 07.06.04 D-05 as the reason the gear sheet is excluded'). Against one aphoristic row, three precise concordant statements give the same numbers (Tier table :84-86, States table :161, D-09 :220), and the Happy Path matches both readings — Sam 'two taps' (:118) is the Tier 1 contributor card, the Producer's 'four seconds' (:119) is D-06's four seconds. No implementer reading a table whose own rationale row says 'D-09 sets the budget' builds a one-tap Producer split sheet.

Quotes verify verbatim (07.04-cx:36; 07.04.02:239; music-projects-collaboration-cx.md:106-111). But the contradiction is not silent — it is explicitly found, adjudicated and recorded in the domain CX at :106-108 ('07.04.02 revised D-03 to say committed artifacts pin — the sibling was right'), which names the authoritative decision. The stale sentence is a CX synthesis answer, not a normative decision, and it is not strictly false: 'updates every downstream reference that is not pinned' remains true when almost everything pins, and it names Release memberships as pinned in the same breath. The failure scenario (a share link whose audio changes) is independently foreclosed by the decision that owns share links, 07.05.02:104 ('Link points at the pinned version it was created for; does not silently follow the canonical') and D-02. Uncorrected editorial debt, not an ambiguity that forces invention.

Quotes verify verbatim (07.05.02:101, :102, :142, :197, :206). Row :102's subject is the COMMENT window — 'Audio dies immediately' is the loose contrast clause setting up the 120 s comment grace, and its rationale sentence is entirely about comments ('Losing feedback someone took the trouble to give is worse than a slightly late close'). Three precise normative statements give one rule: D-15 (:206) 'next segment refused; audible stop <=10 s', D-06 (:197) 'it fails closed within 10 s', States table (:142) 'in-flight playback fails closed within 10 s; in-flight comments accepted 120 s' — the latter states BOTH halves of row :102 in the 10 s form. There is no principled reason audio would behave differently because the recipient happens to be typing; the trigger is identical, so no second rule is being asserted. Operationally 'audible stop within 10 s' IS immediate to a user. Every reasonable reading converges on D-15.

Quotes verify verbatim (07.01-cx:73, :75; index:55). But the role IS scoped: the CX register table in the same file names it — 07.01-cx:12, CX-03 row, Role column = 'Musician'. The blocking question's resolution explicitly closes the CX-03 concern — index:55 ends 'CX-03's "needs validation" note is satisfied' — and supplies the substantive model (07.01.02 D-01 membership edges hold sequence/master/variant; nothing cascades). The asymmetry the finding says must be invented is already stated at sibling 07.01-cx:62 ('you can be on the roster of one Song and have no visibility of the Release it sits on'). The '[PENDING — /ideate-discover Step 5 deepening]' form is a standing tree-wide convention, not a domain-07 defect: 313 occurrences across 234 files, three in this file alone (:40, :61, :73).

The quote verifies verbatim at 07.04-cx:58 and it is indeed the only bare 'Deferred.' in the domain (grep confirms 1 occurrence). But the question is moot in the v1 window, and the leaf that owns comping says so: 07.04.03:104 D-06 — 'Bridge-absent for the whole v1 window, and not re-scoped. No non-web client is authorised (07.09 D-05), so in v1 there is no take ingest and no comp map: every comp lands as an ordinary manually-uploaded version with take lineage marked unavailable, and Empty is the normal state of the take list' (owner ratification DQ-08.2/DQ-08.4). With no take lineage there is no set of 'players whose takes were used' and no comp-completion event carrying that attribution, so there is nothing for an implementer to invent. The adjacent socially-loaded half is separately tracked with owner and re-pointed target — 07.04.03:111 Q-02 '[OWNER] ... | User | /create-prd'.

Quotes verify verbatim (07.08-cx:110, :107, :102; 07.08.05:108, :110, :65). The item carries a '[PENDING — /ideate-discover Step 5 deepening]' marker of the standing tree-wide class (313 occurrences / 234 files), so the question is flagged, not silent. The withdrawal mechanism is already stated as a general property of any published program, not as regret-specific: 07.08.05:65 — 'No undo exists. The files are gone. The platform can stop serving them and cannot recall them.' Roster notification on program events is decided at 07.08-cx:109 and 07.08.05:109 D-03. Crucially the whole feature sits under an unratified ownership boundary with an owner and a live target — 07.08.05:112 D-06 'Proposed boundary: 07 owns the stem set and the clearance gate; 20/21 own the program' and :119 Q-02 '[OWNER] does this feature belong in domain 07 at all? ... | User | /create-prd' — so the post-publication case cannot be authored here until that call lands. Stale target text is cosmetic against three owner-tracked questions over the same feature.

Independently confirmed by exhaustive mechanical resolution of every relative link in the domain: 601 links checked, exactly 5 unresolvable, matching the finding one-for-one. Depth errors — 07.01.02:90 -> ../../07.07-mix-master-workflow/, 07.01.03:141 -> ../../07.06-sessions-documentation-recall/, 07.01.03:142 -> ../../07.08-delivery-readiness-qc/ (all resolve to the ideation root, where the 07.0x sub-domain dirs do not exist; correct depth is ../).
